features:
Key Features:

All-in-one baking mix for pancakes, waffles, biscuits, and more

Made with enriched flour, leavening agents, and vegetable oil

No artificial colors or flavors

Long shelf life — pantry-stable

Quick prep — just add milk, water, or eggs depending on recipe

Benefits:

Saves time in the kitchen — minimal prep required

Highly versatile — works for sweet or savory dishes

Great for beginners — easy to follow instructions

Consistent results — trusted by home cooks since the 1930s

Fortified with iron and B vitamins for added nutrition.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Corn Starch, Vegetable Oil (palm, sunflower, canola, and/or high oleic soybean oil), Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Dextrose, Sugar, Salt, Monoglycerides.
